character: Koom Fluid Scar — 1v1 BARb hard_aggressive war mid; freeze at T2 for a claimable mid-base start
notes: BATTLE FARM (not peaceful co-grow). Two BARb hard_aggressive commanders fight a real 1v1 on Koom Valley until ~T2. Dump → strip factories/mobiles/real coms → keep T2 static eco+teeth + plant decoy nodes on mid. Goal: a denser mid scar than peaceful multi-pocket grow — usable as a T2 starting position (3v3-feel mid without running full 3v3 first). Sims always use NORMAL commanders; occupation uses decoy coms. Optional follow-up: bake_recipe_t2_battle_3v3.json if mid is still too thin.

occupation.notes: After strip, plant decoy farmers on surviving pockets (including mid claim).

playerClear.notes: Reserve NW corner if player later spawns on a shelf; mid claim is the prize.

claim.notes: Compiler / capture phase: treat mid pocket shell as a T2 launch pad (eco + teeth + decoy node), not a full factory base.

starts.label: Central Fluid Scar (claim / T2 mid)
starts.notes: Claim pocket only — not an AI. Strip clustering + decoy plant + T2 start pad.

placeholderDensity.notes: Placeholder only if battle bake not yet run. Real density comes from BARb 1v1 dump.
